content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse, relaxed fit, cropped length, ivory (#FFFFF0), silk satin; High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight cut, full length, charcoal heather (#36454F), wool blend with a touch of elastane; Chunky knit beanie, slouchy fit, oversized length, burnt orange (#CC5500), soft acrylic wool.\n\nThis outfit strikes the perfect balance for a casual Saturday evening birthday celebration in autumn, offering warmth and style without being overly formal. The relaxed silk blouse and comfortable wide-leg trousers ensure you can move freely while dancing or mingling throughout the party, adhering to her request for an \"everyday\" level of dress. The vibrant burnt orange beanie adds a playful pop of color that complements the seasonal atmosphere, while the neutral base tones keep the look effortlessly chic and versatile for any venue."}
